mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT F.FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT F LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION R ON R.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID WHERE F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37' AND F.MDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND R.CDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.AMOUNT > 0

SELECT DISTINCT F.FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT F LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE R ON R.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID WHERE F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37' AND F.MDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.HODING_TYPE = 'A_001' AND R.CDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.AMOUNT > 0 AND R.DATE_TYPE = 0

SELECT R.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, R.FINPROD_ID finprodId, sum(R.AMOUNT) repNomCapi, R.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, F.MDATE mdate, F.VDATE vdate, F.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, sci.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE R LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F ON R.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = R.SEC_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on R.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE R.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND R.CDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.HODING_TYPE = 'A_001' AND R.DATE_TYPE = 0 AND R.AMOUNT > 0 group by R.PORTFOLIO_ID, R.FINPROD_ID, R.SEC_ACCT_ID, F.MDATE, F.VDATE, F.TRADE_MARKET, sci.ACCT_NO

SELECT R.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, R.FINPROD_ID finprodId, sum(R.AMOUNT) repNomCapi, R.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, F.MDATE mdate, F.VDATE vdate, F.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, sci.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION R LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F ON R.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = R.SEC_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on R.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE R.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND R.CDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND R.AMOUNT > 0 group by R.PORTFOLIO_ID, R.FINPROD_ID, R.SEC_ACCT_ID, F.MDATE, F.VDATE, F.TRADE_MARKET, sci.ACCT_NO

SELECT T.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T.SHARE_AMT repNomCapi, T.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secAcctId, T.VDATE vdate, T.MDATE mdate, T.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, T.TRADE_ID tradeId FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD A ON A.TRADE_ID = T.TRADE_ID WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode}
